.github/workflows/ci.yml.text:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    tags: [ 'v*' ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test and Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: fedora:latest

    steps:
      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          dnf install -y \
            git \
            gcc \
            pkgconf-pkg-config \
            gtk4-devel \
            libadwaita-devel \
            meson \
            ninja-build \
            gettext \
            desktop-file-utils \
            appstream \
            rust \
            cargo \
            clippy \
            rustfmt

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check code formatting
        run: cargo fmt --check

      - name: Run clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --all-targets --all-features

      - name: Build and test with Meson
        run: |
          meson setup build
          ninja -C build test

Cargo.toml.text:
[package]
name = "dropzone"
version = "1.1.0"
edition = "2024"
authors = ["dragonGR <alex@debtman.dev>"]
license = "GPL-3.0-or-later"
description = "Temporary file sharing over the local network"
homepage = "https://github.com/dragonGR/dropzone"
repository = "https://github.com/dragonGR/dropzone"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["gnome", "gtk4", "libadwaita", "file-sharing", "lan"]
categories = ["network-programming"]

[dependencies]
gtk4 = { version = "0.11", features = ["v4_16"] }
libadwaita = { version = "0.9", features = ["v1_6"] }
tokio = { version = "1.40", features = ["rt-multi-thread", "macros", "net", "io-util", "fs", "sync"] }
axum = { version = "0.8", default-features = false, features = ["http1", "tokio"] }
tokio-util = { version = "0.7", default-features = false, features = ["io"] }
qrcode = { version = "0.14.1", default-features = false }
if-addrs = "0.15"
rand = "0.8"
gettext-rs = { version = "0.8", features = ["gettext-system"] }

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
panic = "abort"
strip = true
